title: m-Seismo report
description: One bug or crash report sent by an SDK, version 1. See ingestion.md for how it is sent and how the backend answers.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. The backend rejects versions it does not know.

id.description: Report ID, generated on the device when the report is created and kept across retries. It is the idempotency key: the same ID sent twice is stored once. UUIDv7 recommended.

installation_id.description: Anonymous ID of this app installation, generated on first launch and stored on the device. Never derived from a person or a device identifier.

session_id.description: Session the report belongs to; the same value is sent on every request the app makes to our servers. For a crash report, the session that crashed, not the one that sends the report.

occurred_at.description: When the report was triggered on the device. For a crash, when the crash happened. The backend also records when it received the report.

environment.description: Set by the app integrator, e.g. production or staging.

auto_submitted.description: True when the report was sent without showing the report sheet.

consent.description: Why the SDK was allowed to send: the reporter consented, or the mode does not require consent. Without consent the SDK sends nothing.

user_input.description: What the reporter typed in the report sheet. Every field is optional.

device.description: Device and app state at the trigger. A field the integrator masked is left out.

feature_flags.description: Feature flags active at the trigger.

experiments.description: Experiment name to variant the user is in.

logs.description: Most recent app log lines, oldest first, already redacted on the device.

breadcrumbs.description: The user's recent actions, oldest first, already redacted.

crash.description: Required when trigger is crash or non_fatal.

type.description: Exception or signal name, e.g. NSInvalidArgumentException or SIGSEGV.

stack_trace.description: Frames of the crashing thread, innermost first, one per item.

network_requests.description: Recent network requests, oldest first (v1.x). Bodies are present only when bodies_captured is true.

bodies_captured.description: True only when the app integrator turned on request and response bodies. When false, the backend drops any body it receives.

crashlytics.description: Pending decision: the ID that lets the backend find the matching Crashlytics crash.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC with milliseconds, e.g. 2026-10-18T14:03:12.123Z.
